Volume 15 has already changed the era to Kaitai and ends in year six; this unmarked year seven therefore remains Kaitai.

On bingyin day of the fifth month Prince Zongzhen was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang; Zongyuan was made Yongqing Army military commissioner; Zongjian Right Guard senior general; Zongyuan Left Xiao Guard senior general; Zongwei Right Guard senior general; imperial nephew Zongfan Zhaoyi Army military commissioner; Zongxi Zhenguo Army military commissioner; Zongliang Jiang Prefecture military commissioner; Zongbi Pu Prefecture observation commissioner; Zongyi Cao Prefecture defense commissioner; and Zongxian and Zongsu both defense commissioners.

On bingyin day of the fifth month the imperial son Zongzhen was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang; Zōngyuán was made Yongqing Army military commissioner; Zongjian Right Guard senior general; Zōngyuàn Left Xiao Guard senior general; Zongwei Right Guard senior general; imperial nephew Zongfan Zhaoyi Army military commissioner; Zongxi Zhenguo Army military commissioner; Zongliang Jiang Prefecture military commissioner; Zongbi Pu Prefecture observation commissioner; Zongyi Cao Prefecture defense commissioner; and Zongxian and Zongsu both defense commissioners.
皇子 identifies Zongzhen as an imperial son, while 宗元 and 宗願 are distinct men whose names differ only in tone when romanized.

On bingchen day an edict made Eastern Capital Prince Xiao Paiya supreme commander, Palace Front inspector general Xiao Xulie vice commander, and Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage inspector general for a campaign against Goryeo.

On bingchen day an edict made Prince of Dongping Xiao Paiya supreme commander, Palace Front inspector general Xiao Xulie vice commander, and Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage inspector general for a campaign against Goryeo.
東平 is the Dongping fief; Eastern Capital would be 東京.
In the eighth year of Tonghe, in the first spring month Song sent Chen Yaozuo and Zhang Qun with congratulations.
In the eighth year of Kaitai, in the first spring month Song sent Chen Yaozuo and Zhang Qun with congratulations.
The unmarked eighth year continues Kaitai, following Kaitai year seven in this annal.
In the eighth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, Song sent Chen Yaozuo and Zhang Qun to congratulate.
In the eighth year of Kaitai, spring, first month, Song sent Chen Yaozuo and Zhang Qun to congratulate.
The unmarked eighth year continues Kaitai, following Kaitai year seven in this annal.

On yihai day Eastern Capital Prince Xiao Hanning, Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage, imperial uncle-in-law Associate Grand Chancellor Xiao Paiya, linya Yaozhi, and others returned from the Goryeo campaign; charged with violating military discipline, their crimes were enumerated and they were released.

The text contrasts Prince of Dongping (東平王) with the Eastern Capital regent (東京留守).
